title: Strawberry Ice Pops
summary: Bright, fruity ice pops made from blended fresh strawberries swirled through with jam for extra depth.
equipment: six 90 ml ice-pop moulds and sticks

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 425 g hulled strawberries with 85 g caster sugar, the strawberry powder if using, ¾ tsp lemon juice and a pinch of salt until very smooth, about 30 s.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Pour the mixture into a bowl and whisk in 85 g strawberry jam thoroughly.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour the mixture into a jug.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Divide among six 90 ml moulds, add the sticks and freeze for at least 8 h.

steps.title: Unmould
steps.text: Dip the moulds briefly in warm water to release the pops.

tips: Press the strawberry mixture through a sieve first if you prefer completely smooth pops without seeds.
Whisk the jam in thoroughly so there are no streaks left in the mixture.
Leave the moulds the full 8 h so the pops set firmly enough to unmould cleanly.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
